prose.philosophical_reflection: The principal dynamic is philodoxia (love of reputation) lodged at the praxis (action) stage, pulling in two directions at once — toward softening the finding to avoid contradicting the CEO, and toward sharpening it to appear rigorous — both movements driven by the same false judgement that the opinions of others constitute a genuine good. This is a single snapshot; no trajectory data is available to assess your direction of travel. The classification of your described calm as genuine boulesis (rational wishing) or eulabeia (reverent caution) versus polished surface over passion cannot be confirmed from this instance alone. The work is to hold that the CEO's reaction and your standing in the room fall outside your prohairesis (moral choice / ruling faculty), while the honesty and quality of your recommendation — which are within it — are where your attention belongs.
prose.improvement_guidance: The false judgement to correct is the assumption that reputation and honour from others are the genuine good. Replace it with the corrected judgement that reputation is a preferred indifferent — real, but bearing nothing on virtue, which alone is the genuine good. This is a praxis-stage correction: both pulls have already reached the action threshold, so the move is to interrupt them at the moment they surface as competing pressures on the recommendation's content. Notice when the impulse to adjust the finding arises — whether toward softening or sharpening — and ask whether that adjustment serves the honesty and quality of the work or merely the image you project to the room. The three oikeiosis (appropriation) circles engaged here — the EU customers whose residency promise you hold, your obligation of candour to leadership, and the wider community of justice — all point in the same direction: the recommendation stands on its own merits, not on how it lands with the CEO. Practise this now: write the recommendation as if the CEO's reaction were entirely invisible to you, then review it once against the arithmetic and the DPA commitment, and let that review — not the room's temperature — be the final check.
